characters.description: Ennis Nott's resourceful daughter and an unlicensed novice sorcerer. Wanted after her father leaves her exposed during a crime, she slips back into a watched inn for her magical belongings and escapes only after an unexplained transformation gives her a male body.
characters.name: Siobhan

characters.description: Siobhan's absent father, sought by officers for unlicensed thaumaturgy. He occupied the watched inn room and left Siobhan facing the consequences of the crime and flight, giving her reason to blame him for her danger.
characters.name: Ennis Nott

characters.description: A well-dressed, dark-haired stranger who pulls Siobhan into hiding during her flight from the officers. He witnesses her sudden physical transformation and helps her pass as an unrelated male bystander.
characters.name: Unnamed stranger

characters.description: The stranger who helped Siobhan evade the officers. He has criminal associates and offers to connect her with people who could finance a university education under a new male identity.
characters.name: Oliver Dryden

characters.description: The manager of Oliver's establishment and a lender willing to finance Siobhan's university education. Her terms carry steep interest and require magical service if money falls short, with only narrow protection against objectionable assignments.
characters.name: Katerine

characters.description: A red-haired boy at Katerine's establishment who hopes to learn magic. He admits Oliver and Siobhan when they arrive and shows curiosity about the sorcerers around him.
characters.name: Theo

characters.description: The male identity Oliver creates for Siobhan from an extinct noble line, intended to carry her safely through university admission. She must learn the manner and presentation expected of a wealthy young man while concealing both her fugitive status and the artifact behind the change.
characters.name: Sebastien Siverling

characters.description: The female identity used by the same person known as Siobhan and Sebastien Siverling. She changes which identity she presents while pursuing university admission and trying to contact her imprisoned father without exposing herself.
characters.name: Chauvin

characters.description: A privileged applicant from a powerful Crown family. He tries to use his rank to move ahead in the university admissions queue, but Sebastien publicly refuses to yield and turns their first meeting into a confrontation.
characters.name: Damien Westbay

characters.description: A renowned university professor and master of freecasting whom Siobhan recognizes on sight. He ends Damien's admissions-queue dispute, rebuking the younger man before taking him away.
characters.name: Thaddeus Lacer

characters.description: An independent, unlicensed sorcerer who sells powerful clandestine services from a carefully warded workspace. She agrees to help Chauvin reach Ennis in prison, but demands substantial payment and a reciprocal blood-print vow of secrecy.
characters.name: Liza

characters.description: A professor on Sebastien's oral admissions panel who challenges his weak formal grounding with hostile history questions. His examination emphasizes how far Sebastien's practical talent has outpaced his conventional education.
characters.name: Professor Munchworth

characters.description: Damien's unnamed older brother, a Crown-family investigator who leads the search for Siobhan. He directs the local coppers and strengthens the wards around Ennis's cell after the prison messenger narrows the search.
characters.name: Damien's older brother

characters.description: Head of the Westbay Crown family and father of Titus and Damien. He publicly belittles Damien's entrance ranking at an elite gathering until Thaddeus Lacer intervenes in the younger man's defense.
characters.name: Tyron Westbay

characters.description: Damien's elder brother and an influential member of the Westbay family. In conversation with Oliver, he suggests that growing restrictions might eventually push powerful people toward political change, while offering no firm support.
characters.name: Titus Westbay

characters.description: A noble host pursued by Oliver as a potential business contact. The prospect of using Oliver's rare Erythrian horses secures agreement to discuss commercial matters another time.
characters.name: Lord Girvan

characters.description: A fourth-term student liaison assigned to orient Sebastien's incoming cohort. She explains the university's competition, discipline, housing pressures, and genuine risk of magical accidents while fielding gossip about his unusual admission.
characters.name: Tanya Canelo

characters.description: A fourth-term student liaison helping Sebastien's cohort settle into university life. He provides practical guidance about housing, discipline, contribution points, and student support.
characters.name: Newton Moore

characters.description: A Master Sorcerer who teaches Introduction to Modern Magics. Her first lesson stresses the need for a safe conduit and warns students about failed circles, will strain, bodily conduits, blood magic, and corruption.
characters.name: Professor Burberry

characters.description: A natural-science professor who treats careful knowledge of physical reality as a way to expand magic beyond inherited methods. The course gives Sebastien a disciplined framework for questioning accepted explanations.
characters.name: Professor Norrish

characters.description: Sebastien's dormmate and Alec Gervin's cousin, who recognizes him from the admissions process and asks to be called Anna. She offers an early social connection amid his otherwise isolated university routine.
characters.name: Anna Gervin

characters.description: Anna Gervin's cousin, whom she identifies while introducing herself to Sebastien.
characters.name: Alec Gervin

characters.description: A history professor who favors critical interpretation over memorized answers. She assigns students to compare explanations for humanity's early magic and the disappearance of older powerful species.
characters.name: Professor Ilma

characters.description: A former soldier who teaches defensive magic as a discipline of survival. His course begins with physical training and emphasizes preparation, escape, and staying functional under dangerous conditions.
characters.name: Elwood Fecton

characters.description: The professor of sympathetic science, teaching magical associations through metaphor and culture. Sebastien presses for evidence about whether collective beliefs create those links, but receives no definite answer.
characters.name: Professor Pacanti

characters.description: A Verdant Stag enforcer entrusted with field command. Oliver sends him to lead an emergency team rescuing a girl held by the Morrows, making him part of the organization's growing public-response work.
characters.name: Gerard

characters.description: The captain of a small smuggling fleet and a prospective supplier for Oliver. He agrees to conceal magical plants, artifacts, and alchemical materials among legitimate imports in return for premium payment.
characters.name: Captain Eliezer

characters.description: A member of the study group practicing Thaddeus Lacer's supplementary exercises. He works with Alec on a miniature magical dueling game while Sebastien and Damien test their control.
characters.name: Rhett Moncrief

characters.description: One of the students in Anna and Damien's early-morning practice group for Thaddeus Lacer's demanding supplementary exercises. Waverly joins the new circle in which Sebastien's rivalry becomes shared training.
characters.name: Waverly Ascot

characters.description: A shy member of the early-morning study group formed around Thaddeus Lacer's supplementary casting exercises. Bryn practices alongside Sebastien, Damien, Anna, Alec, Rhett, and Waverly.
characters.name: Bryn

characters.description: A Verdant Stag warehouse worker found dead beneath a collapsed support beam after the Morrows' assault. His death makes the human cost of the attack immediate as Chauvin and Oliver search the wreckage.
characters.name: Cooper

characters.description: A Verdant Stag warehouse worker left with a critical neck wound after the Morrows' attack. Chauvin uses healing supplies and a flesh-mirroring spell to stop the bleeding, though his severe blood loss remains life-threatening.
characters.name: Jameson

characters.description: Liza's half-troll supplier within the hidden Nightmarket trade. His heritage allows repeated journeys into elemental planes, giving him access to unusual materials and an otherwise difficult supply network.
characters.name: Harvester

characters.description: The investigators' unofficial public codename for Siobhan, inspired by raven imagery and alarming reports about the magic used during her escape from the warehouse attack.
characters.name: Raven Queen
